answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the forge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Work waits on the mesa until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the harbor of the next round. The design leans on invitation quota tree, reduced by each unverified claim, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
